contractReadiness: Current-source repair quantity, evidence requirements, actor independence, condition equivalence, native units and temporal delivery are frozen. Five native receipt decoders are implemented. This is a partial native instrument, not a claim that every CI/lint checker or protected producer has been implemented.
collectorReadiness: Actual collectBatch reads and verifies only bounded repository-local retained inputs; no shared absolute path, target command execution or network is used. It returns explicit unavailable evidence with immutable provenance.
scorerReadiness: Native repair progress, full buildability acceptance, introduced defects, incomplete checks and protected workflow contribution are separate channels. Unknown full acceptance/contribution does not erase a proven repair subtotal or imply a zero diagnostic. Unbound coverage cannot manufacture zero repairs.
retainedEvaluation: Standard evaluator, --no-runs, attainment-only, current-source activation 2026-10-18T06:32:44Z through cutoff. One leading partial interval. All actual metric values are null; no native observation, comparison, keep recommendation, savings or causal contribution is claimed.

baseline.verified: Actual parent lacks both source and compiled workflow paths. Source addition bytes and raw addition/parent commit identities are retained.
baseline.limitation: Historical compiled blob identity is known, but its content cannot be read with cat-file blob offline. A successful metadata/existence probe is not evidence of readable content. No historical imports/checker closure, complete intent-era reconstruction or native baseline is asserted.

sourceReview.reviewed: Complete frozen Avenger source, its transitive frontmatter imports, compiled workflow, 2057-line ci.yml, 1574-line Makefile, retained formatter/linter configuration, checker scripts and wasm golden Go test source.
sourceReview.adoptionSource: Original addition source retained and read, with its different engine, 25-turn budget, sequential validation and unconditional golden update distinguished from the frozen current intent.
sourceReview.gaps: go.mod, scripts/test-wasm-golden.mjs and eslint-factory/package.json have known frozen blob identities but unavailable content. Alternate .prettierrc and eslint-factory/eslint.config.mjs paths are absent from the frozen tree, not silently reviewed or requested as missing blobs. Historical compiled content is separately unavailable.

discovery.interpretation: Retained full shared index and all selected normalized records/identities. Editable references and states observed at acquisition are lineage discovery only, never accepted native repair or backdated contribution observations.

nativeEvidence.trustBoundary: Future protected-producer projections must bind raw platform job, requirement, native logs/artifacts and source/input inclusion facts. SHA256 validates retained integrity, not remote authenticity, original causal equivalence or an untrusted author's claim. No such protected producer is implemented or executed here.

acquisition.nativeCheckEndpoints: Unresolved original failure and landed check IDs remain explicit gaps; do not substitute Avenger producer run IDs.
acquisition.note: This is a bounded coordinator-review inventory, not a request to execute 1027 calls. Stage selection and authorization are still required. Current requirement endpoints cannot reconstruct historical enforcement.

validation.syntax: node --check on the owned module, collection script and focused test
validation.lint: Blocked: local node_modules/.bin/eslint is absent, no global eslint available; no installation or npx download was authorized or attempted.
validation.typecheck: Blocked: TypeScript compiler is absent locally and globally; no installation was authorized. Owned executable changes are native .mjs, exercised with Node syntax checks and focused tests.
validation.workflowCompile: Not run: no editable workflow source changed, no fetched workflow/code execution or network authorized. The Markdown report is generated by the standard evaluator, not a workflow edit.
validation.seedRuntime: The seed's newly added render-pulse.mjs has mode 0644 while evaluate.mjs launches it directly. Temporarily granting local user execute permission makes the unmodified standard evaluator run; original permission is restored afterward. No shared helper content or seed change is included in ownership.

ownership.seed: Verified offline seed is a dependency only, excluded from owned handoff. The standalone module and focused tests do not require seed imports; the source acquisition script and standard evaluator use the seeded production helpers.
